title: Why Do We Have Skin?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Have Skin.
It keeps water in and many germs out.
Let me show you that in 3D.
It feels heat, cold, and touch.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Skin is a living wrap.
The pictures today are a new hand world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we have skin.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
